title: classification_table.json
description: A systematic mapping study's classified-study table (docs/PLAN.md M3; references/docs/design/multi-method-consensus.md §3.1 S5, §3.3 'Systematic mapping study'). Written by the (not-yet-shipped) evidence-mapping skill once a method manifest's capture.mode is "classification". The scheme is built by keywording a sample (pack-supplied candidate facets; Wieringa research types), frozen, then applied to every study; a calibration re-code (inter-rater when two coders, delayed intra-rater re-code of >=10 records when one) discloses agreement/disagreement rather than hiding it.

scheme_frozen.description: False while facets are still being built by keywording a sample; once true, facets[] may no longer change without a documented scheme amendment.

facets.description: The frozen classification scheme's facets and their allowed categories -- empty while scheme_frozen is false.

agreement.description: Simple agreement or a chance-corrected statistic, whichever was computed -- disclosed either way, never hidden.

calibration.description: Recorded once the calibration re-code has run (docs/PLAN.md M3 exit criterion: bulk coding is blocked until scheme_frozen is true; calibration itself is disclosed, not gated).

codes.description: One key per frozen facets[] name, value one of that facet's categories (or an array of categories for a multi-valued facet).
